notes: s2f1: the sentence also places the cemetery 'north of Tell es-Simadi' (relative to another site); W from the site itself used. s2f2: Abel's report quoted in the entry; 'the farm' is not identified, so relative_to other. Abel's 'caves at the foot of the hill' with two hewn graves and the lead sarcophagus are read as the same burial caves and kept as one feature. s2f3: Site 85 has no plan of its own; Fig. 167 (Plan of Tell es-Simadi and the town of Coraea) labels a 'Pool' on the tell, so it takes row S1116's point (grid). The text above the figure on p. 281 belongs to the Site 84 entry and was not coded. Unit point cannot be placed on Fig. 167 (unit point is 400 m S of S1116 and the plan spans c. 450 m), so no plan positions. Data block 'Cisterns: none' recorded as C2 absence.
